name: io.github.cyanheads/interpro-mcp-server
description: Search InterPro entries, map domains onto proteins and PDB structures, and scan raw sequences.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: INTERPRO_SCAN_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact email the EBI Job Dispatcher requires to submit InterProScan jobs. Optional: without it interpro_scan_sequence still returns precalculated matches for sequences already in UniParc and fails other sequences as scan_not_configured, and interpro_get_scan_result still reads existing jobs. EBI stores the address with job data for seven days, and one address covers every caller of the server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
